newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs up on short-covering and chemical interest.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs up on short-covering and chemical interest.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices rose in moderate trade on Friday as some short covering and petrochemical demand put pressure on values, players said.
A sharp rise in NYMEX futures also added to upward pressure on LPGs.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane was up a half cent in the afternoon to between 35.75 cents and 36.00 cents a gallon. 35.75 cent deals were done.
Conway, Kansas, material rose 0.75 cent to deals done at 37.25 cents.
Players said there were several shorts covered on propane ahead of the weekend as well as some petrochemical interest.
Meanwhile, normal butane prices rose a quarter cent to 42.00/42.25 cents. Conway material was up 0.75 cent to 38.50 cents.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk, 1 212 859 1631
